name: Tether
author: Erin Carter
description: Glowing lights over dark water at night: lamps drift slowly upward like rising lanterns (or downward like sinking embers) through the air above a waterline, each throwing a long shimmering reflection down the black water that wavers and refracts as the surface stirs. Multi-hued embers on dark glass, their mirrored streaks breaking into rippling distorted bands.

params.label: Rise / fall
params.effect: Vertical drift of the lamps — positive rises them like lanterns, negative sinks them like embers, 0 leaves them hovering in place.

params.label: Swell speed
params.effect: Rate of the ripple shimmer travelling down the reflections — 0 stills the water to glass, high keeps the surface stirring.

params.label: Reflection length
params.effect: Length and strength of the water reflections — 0 leaves just the lamps and a glint at the waterline, 2 streams long luminous columns down the whole water.

params.label: Reflection distortion
params.effect: How much the reflection columns waver and refract with depth — 0 gives clean mirror streaks, high gives a heavily disturbed, broken-up surface.

params.label: Lamp glow
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of each lamp's glow core, from pinprick lights to broad lanterns.

params.label: Lamp density
params.effect: How many lamps fill the scene — low scatters a sparse few, high crowds the air with a dense drift of lights.
